main_text.p: dicans non intelligat, Nos divina providentia in normam & correctionem aliorum electos ef-fe, ideoq; iustum, dilectam hanc congregatio-nem eius, insigni & speciofo aliquo vocabulo a tot Monachorum & Fraternitatum inutili-bus sectis distingui. Præterea & hoc reprehen-dunt, quod recusemus ciliciis vestiri, aut cibis pasci rusticis: sed illudentes, dicunt, nos vesti-bus vti ex lana tenuissima, & cutem tegere cā-didissimo linteo, nutritos optimis & delicatis-simis cibis, qui vel in Vrbe, vel territoriis vici-nis reperiantur. Insuper, nolle nos in pagis ha-bitare, aut sub tectis humilibus: sed cum a Pa-tribus nostris, varias mundi partes peragranti-bus, omnis commoditas atq; venustas excogi-tata sit; possidere[?] nos (dicunt) in omnibus re-gnis & provinciis Christianissimi, meliores & præstantiores situs atque Palatia, quàm alibi haberi queant, non quidem in Villis & Castel-lis casas fundantes, sed in Vrbibus primariis, & iis rebus abundantibus, quæ generi humano possint sufficere. Sed neque sic Ædes illas ac-ceptari, nisi prius & reditus, & habitationes pro Patrum & Coadiutorum temporaliū nu-mero ibi fuerint præparatæ. Non animaduer-tuntautem[?] affectibus corrupti obtrectatores, id, quod de vestimentis, cibis & habitationi-bus dicunt, ad summam laudem Societatis to-tius, & Patris Ignatii primi Institutoris nostri vergere. qui vt omnium hominum sapientissi-mus vestes incultas, cilicia, & cibos agrestes,

page.notes: Catchword "quæ" is printed alone at the lower right, below the last full line. The scan is slightly faded and the lower-left corner shows a small stain, which is not transcribed. Uncertain readings: "possidere" (the scan is faded at this word) and "tuntautem" (the spacing is unclear). The "ct" in "dilectam" and "s" forms were read as printed, with long s written as s.
